text:
Alex: Heads up — planning to flip dedicated-slice-42 autoscale policy tonight 2026-03-17 20:00 UTC. Change is small but important: min instances 2 -> 4, burst threshold 0.60 -> 0.75. Who can own the rollout + smoke?
Cheng: I can take the deployment. Will do canary then stagger. Window works for me.
Maria: I’ll run the smoke checklist and perf traces during canary. Ping me when canary is up.
Priya: I’ll be rollback standby and have the snapshot + rollback script ready. Where is the rollback runbook?
Cheng: Rollout plan (short):
- 20:00 start canary on slice-42-canary
- 20:03 warmup + KV-cache priming
- 20:10 run smoke checks
- 20:15 evaluate metrics, if OK stagger to next 3 slices with 5m spacing
- 20:45 post-rollout monitoring window
Priya: Rollback runbook is in the ops repo: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/rollbacks#slice-rollback and quick script ./rollback-slice.sh slice-42 (requires infra group perms). I have it staged.
Maria: Smoke checklist (condensed):
1) Run smoke script against canary
2) Tail inference logs for evictions / CUDA OOMs
3) Check app-level p95 < 250ms and error rate < 0.5%
4) Verify autoscaler metrics (util, pending, replicas) are sane
5) Spot-check billing/throughput metrics for immediate spikes

Smoke command I’ll run:
```
./smoke.sh --pool slice-42-canary --qps 5 --check-kv-cache --duration 120
```
Cheng: deploy-bot scheduled the change: deploy-bot: "scheduled autoscale-policy-update for dedicated-slice-42 by Cheng at 2026-03-17T20:00:00Z (CID: d2f6b9)."
SRE-oncall: I’ll watch infra alerts. If we see repeated OOMs or pod evictions within 10m of canary start, we should abort and rollback. I can mute noisy low-severity alerts for the window.
Alex: Rollback criteria shorthand: any p95 regression > 40% vs baseline OR >0.5% new 5xx rate OR any GPU OOM/eviction spike. If rollback needed, Priya executes ./rollback-slice.sh and Cheng posts status.
Maria: Canary up now. Running smoke.
Maria: Smoke results: p95 180ms, errors 0.08%, no evictions in logs, KV hit stable, surge metric steady. :thumbsup:
Cheng: Good. Starting staggered rollout to slice-42-a/b/c with 5m spacing. I’ll post each slice completion.
Priya: I’m standing by in case rollback triggered. I have access and will run script if you call it.
SRE-oncall: Monitoring dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/slices/slice-42 — keeping an eye on node memory and GPU metrics.
Cheng: Slice-42-a done, slice-42-b starting. No issues so far.
Maria: Quick note — observed small transient CPU rise during warmup but back to baseline after priming.
Alex: Thanks team. Once full rollout done, can we update the infra changelog and schedule a short retro if anything odd?
Cheng: Will post ops summary and changelog entry once done. ETA 21:00 UTC to close the thread.
deploy-bot: "completed staged rollout for dedicated-slice-42 at 2026-03-17T20:38:12Z (CID: d2f6b9)."
Cheng: Rollout complete. No rollbacks, monitoring window OK. Closing out.
